Ensure internal interfaces between various spacecraft subsystems are maintained. Contribute to requirements management ensuring all requirements are closed-out at the planned project landmarks. Support AIT/Flight&Test Operations Groups and subsystem leads in defining test plans and specifications which will successfully verify the spacecraft design.
